impact.text: Users may unknowingly send funds to ROUTER expecting a stateless routing behavior.

precondition_sources.text: The router is intended to be used via delegatecall from a smart wallet or shim contract, so address(this) resolves to the wallet/shim and _getSelfBalance tracks the wallet's balances.

intent_sources.text: The router must remain pure logic with no long-term funds; all balances belong to the calling wallet, so direct calls must not cause the router to accumulate and control user funds.
